{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "threshold": 100.0,
            "threshold_operator": "=",
            "penalty_amount": 2000,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 20,
            "description": "20% penalty if availability impact reaches 100%",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "QueryFailureRatePercentage",
            "threshold": 50.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">=",
            "penalty_amount": 1000,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 10,
            "description": "10% penalty if query failure rate is 50% or higher",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 5.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if initial response time is more than 5 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_004",
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 60.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 1500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 15,
            "description": "15% penalty if resolution time exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "condition": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage = 100",
            "penalty_rule": "20% penalty if availability impact reaches 100%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "QueryFailureRatePercentage",
            "condition": "QueryFailureRatePercentage >= 50",
            "penalty_rule": "10% penalty if query failure rate is 50% or higher"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty if initial response time is more than 5 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "ResolutionTimeMinutes > 60",
            "penalty_rule": "15% penalty if resolution time exceeds 60 minutes"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, DetectedAt, CASE WHEN AvailabilityImpactPercentage = 100 THEN 2000 WHEN QueryFailureRatePercentage >= 50 THEN 1000 WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5 THEN 500 WHEN ResolutionTimeMinutes > 60 THEN 1500 ELSE 0 END AS RecoveryAmount FROM incidents_database_service WHERE AvailabilityImpactPercentage = 100 OR QueryFailureRatePercentage >= 50 OR InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5 OR ResolutionTimeMinutes > 60",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DetectedAt", "AvailabilityImpactPercentage", "QueryFailureRatePercentage", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes", "ResolutionTimeMinutes"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 50
}
